deploy-bot: Starting percent rollout: service=ingest-proxy model=rw-embed-2.0 -> 6% traffic to canary in eu-west1. release_notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.0
tara: change window check - this is inside the 01:00-04:00 UTC slot, ops confirmed.
noah: quick FYI: this includes the new quantization path. bench showed fewer tokens/sec on long sequences, but latency tail impact unknown.
isabel: can we isolate the canary to the low-QPS shard to minimize blast radius?
noah: yes - routing rule applied (shard 'probe-eu-lowqps'). pin older nodes out of LB for duration.
isabel: smoke checklist: p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, rpc timeouts, encoder mem usage. ops-bot: thresholds posted -> p99 +180ms OR 5xx > 0.3% OR encoder-oom >=1 -> abort.
tara: abort authority = release_lead + infra_oncall. release_lead=tara, infra_oncall=noah.
deploy-bot: shift started at 6129994412. canary pods can-embed-3, can-embed-4. health=passing. logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/rollout/6129994412
isabel: starting synthetic embed probes and similarity checks. will post results in 5min.
noah: noticed small uptick in p99 for >1024 token inputs (+95ms). not at threshold. monitoring.
isabel: probe @6129994440: p95 +40ms, p99 +92ms, 5xx 0.01%, encoder-oom 0/min, embed-sim drift 0.7%.
tara: ok to continue to 15% in 7m if stable. any objections?
noah: none. rolling. rollback command pinned: ```kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/ingest-proxy --to-revision=stable-1.9.8```
isabel: prepping hotfix branch hotfix/quant-fallback if drift increases.
ops-bot: automated alert thresholds armed. will post if any trigger.
deploy-bot: status @6129994460: canary=6% p99 +88ms, 5xx 0.02%, embed-drift 0.9% -> no abort triggers.
tara: staging ramp to 15% on hold until next health window. will confirm in 5m.
historia: logging note - make sure to snapshot KV cache stats before 15% ramp; cross-version evict patterns can be subtle.
